Definition: properly, incised or (active) incisive; hence (as noun masculine or feminine) a trench (as dug), gold (as mined), a threshing-sledge (having sharp teeth); (figuratively) determination; also eager
BiblicalUsage: Charuwts is sharp, incisive, a threshing instrument, a trench, a decision, and it cuts in every use. Damascus threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron, the fitches are not threshed with a threshing instrument but beaten out with a staff, the multitudes stand in the valley of decision, and Daniel hears that the street shall be built again, and the wall, even in troublous times.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word is sharp on purpose: threshing separates grain from chaff, and decision separates the peoples in the valley. Isaiah's farmer knows which tool fits which seed, and God knows which judgment fits which nation. I hold that God's sharpness is never careless, and the threshing floor is where the harvest is proved.
RelatedTopics: Judgment; Prophecy; Day of the Lord
